blinding: Condition labels are absent from stimulus filenames presented to raters; use stimulus_id. This file contains the key and must not be shown to raters.

does_not_prove: anything at all until human raters respond
that any embedding score corresponds to perception

preregistration.adversarial_control_purpose: A deliberately mismatched cheerful delivery of a firm-boundary sentence. If listeners cannot separate it from the dream condition, the emotion channel carries no perceptible signal.
preregistration.analysis: Report raw counts per condition per measure with Wilson 95% intervals. No LLM judge; no self-rating by the agent.
preregistration.hypothesis: Listeners recognize the dream-derived session mood above chance, and rate the dream condition as recognizably Embry at parity with control.
measures_in_order: target-emotion recognition (forced choice among the four tone labels)
content equivalence (does the sentence mean the same thing? yes/no)
preference (secondary, reported but not used for the primary claim)
preregistration.primary_measure: target-emotion recognition accuracy for the dream condition
preregistration.rater_inclusion_rule_fixed_before_analys: Exclude a rater only if the adversarial condition is judged as the target emotion of the dream condition, which indicates they were not attending. Declared before any response is collected.
preregistration.stopping_rule: Fixed n=20 raters. No interim analysis, no extension after seeing results.

stimulus_source.answer_text: I need you to wait before you commit to that plan, because the constraint changed this morning.
stimulus_source.note: Identical answer text and identical speaker reference across all four conditions; only voice_delivery differs. That is what makes the comparison matched.
